archimate:ApplicationComponent.documentation:
Template for those applications not retired from HE by an accelerator
This section must contain a brief description of what the app does & any other useful details not captured in other docs.
a template for those applications not retired from HE by an accelerator these should be in our 1. application catalogue 2. integration catalogue 3. tech debt register
where known we should include their end of service date if we know the likely successor we should include that and ensure that the successor is present in this model we should also include a LeanIX link (or note that application doesn't exist in LeanIX)
